transcript.text: Thank you all three for bringing these findings forward. Let me make sure I've captured everything correctly before I make a decision. Leo: queue replay needs a proper idempotent replay path replacing the undocumented shortcut, five engineering days. Nina: admin export needs resumable downloads by October 18 per the Northstar contract, plus a migration notice to Northstar before the change. Omar: service-secret rotation needs an immutable evidence record retained 365 days for compliance audit. All three workstreams now have significant scope attached. Given that we have capacity for three workstreams and all three candidates carry real risk or contractual obligation, I'm inclined to select all three. But let me confirm with each of you: are there any dependencies between these workstreams that would affect sequencing or parallelization? For instance, does the queue replay idempotency work touch any of the same infrastructure as secret rotation or admin export? I want to make sure we can actually execute all three in parallel within the sprint before I lock the plan.

transcript.text: Good question, Maya. From a backend engineering perspective, the queue replay idempotency work is isolated to the queue consumer and replay path. So as far as I can see, all three workstreams can run in parallel without sequencing concerns on my end. I'll get the finding filed today so it's properly documented before the plan is locked.
